verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say users who are not signed in can still send multi-protocol requests in a lightweight API client, so some account-free use exists. Nothing documents a local workspace or full offline operation, and community users report it now requires cloud connectivity and is increasingly restrictive to non-logged-in users. missing for 10: documented local/offline workspace, saving collections and environments locally without an account, a guarantee of no cloud connectivity, independent corroboration of offline use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can work fully offline in a local workspace without a cloud account

citations.quote: If you're not signed in to a Postman account, you can still send multi-protocol requests using the lightweight API client.
